const github.com/iksnerd/json-bourne/jb.EstateDriftNote untyped string = "Drift is a difference between two passive observations of the estate, not proof of compromise and not attribution: an address, prefix or origin AS that belongs to a CDN, proxy or shared host changes for reasons that say nothing about ownership. Only observations made by the same source and the same method are compared; anything else is listed as not comparable. A name on a certificate is a candidate, not a live host. An estate map shows infrastructure, not who typed the commands."
